The '''''Backbreaker''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigate]] in service to [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] and part of his [[Group Three (Zsinj)|third group]]. It was present, alongside the rest of the group, at the [[Battle of Levian Two]] after being called in to reinforce Zsinj's [[Group One (Zsinj)|first group]] in order to ambush [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Solo's]] [[Solo Fleet|fleet]].

It was again present at [[Selaggis VI|Selaggis]], having once more joined Zsinj's [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|Iron Fist]] in battle against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces. The third group was moving through the systems [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]], with Backbreaker in the centre of the line, in an attempt to reach the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Super Star Destroyer]] when Solo's fleet engaged them from the rear.

== Behind the scenes ==
While the Backbreaker first appears in Aaron Allstons Solo Command, the ship is never directly named. It is only identified as Backbreaker through an FAQ on Allstons website, identifying the recurring lancer frigate as such.<ref name="AllstonWebsite">{{WebCite|url=http://www.aaronallston.com/factpages/faq_starwars.html|text=(Aaron Allston's Web Site) FAQ: Star Wars Novels|author=Aaron Allston|date=2013-01-15|work=[https://web.archive.org/web/20150102092638/http://www.aaronallston.com/factpages/faq_starwars.html#solo Aaron Allston's Web Site]|archivedate=20150102092638}}</ref>
